ns2:section.sectionText: Race and Sentencing Policy?This course will consider the basic theories of criminal punishment and the specific problem of racial disparity in sentencing, with a focus on African-Americans. We will examine the substantive and procedural rules that relate to sentencing in state and federal courts, including the use of sentencing guideline systems, and their impact on African-American defendants and communities. Students will be required to travel to a regional correctional institution or attend a sentencing hearing. Students will be evaluated on class presentations and a 10-page paper.
